format_note: Mirrors rootcommit/v2-sig (see rootcommit/SPEC_SIG.md in this repository): the preimage commits the SIGNER, the signature is carried alongside rather than hashed in. The tag is ours, on a domain we control, per the domain/purpose/object/version convention in rootcommit/SPEC.md.

source_receipt.attestation_domain_note: eip155:421614 is Arbitrum Sepolia — a frozen, pre-audit EIP-712 SIGNING namespace, deliberately not a settlement rail. The USDC settlement in this same receipt is Base mainnet (eip155:8453). The domain is not a preimage line in v2-sig because the EIP-712 digest already commits to the full domain separator (name, version, chainId, verifyingContract).

delivery.signature_note: EIP-712 PayloadAttestation signature, recoverable to `signer`. Carried alongside, NOT hashed into the commitment.
